about_short_description.short_description: KIB is a bank that provides financial, investment, banking, and internet banking services.

product.name: KIB Internet Banking
product.description: An online banking service for managing accounts and finances, reviewing balances and activity, and making local and international transfers through a secure web platform.

product.name: KIB Mobile Banking
product.description: A mobile banking application for managing accounts, reviewing balances and transactions, and making local and international transfers on supported mobile devices.

product.name: Murabaha Financing
product.description: An Islamic financing service based on Murabaha structures, available through an application process for customers seeking Sharia-compliant financing.

product.name: KIB Credit Cards
product.description: Credit card products for KIB customers, with applications available through the bank’s digital and service channels.

product.name: Islamic Deposit (الوديعة الإسلامية)
product.description: A fixed-term Islamic deposit available in Kuwaiti dinar, US dollar, British pound, and euro, with profit paid at maturity and a stated minimum opening amount of KWD 100,000 or equivalent.

product.name: Corporate Online Banking
product.description: An online banking service for business customers that provides remote access to corporate account and transaction management.
